dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Conch Gang...

dialogues.speaker: Jurva
dialogues.text: It is said that Nasha Town was first built by a group of children. Whenever they had a decision to make, they'd blow into a conch shell to gather the group, and everyone would vote on it.

dialogues.speaker: Jurva
dialogues.text: But that's just a folk tale, and nobody really believes it happened. Which does make me wonder... Who even made these stories up in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Jurva
dialogues.text: The Conch Gang these days... We're just a bunch of stray kids who drifted together. Ah, but now we've got Katya watching over us. I really can't thank her enough.
